Subject: Staggered enablement windows + prework checklist

Hi Alice,

Thanks again for the interest in a hands-on enablement. Based on our earlier convo I wanted to propose a dual-window approach so we can accommodate both your US product team and EMEA devs without making a single full-day session. Idea:

- Option A (US-friendly): Console walkthrough (45m) + brief Q&A (15m) — 2027-05-05 10:00–11:00 PT
- Option B (EMEA-friendly): API enablement + labs (60–75m) — 2027-05-06 16:00–17:15 PT (works as morning in Europe)

If splitting across two windows is okay, we can have Laura lead the Console session and Jordan run the API labs. I attached a short prework checklist that helps us avoid environment/setup delays (enablement_prework.pdf). Can you confirm:

1) Rough attendee list by role (product/dev/security)
2) Any firewall/network requirements we should prep for (IP allowlist, jump hosts)
3) Preference for concrete times above or alternative slots (we can slide both by 1–2 hours)

Quick note: I included a calendar link and a shared Drive folder with the prework and an agenda draft in the links below.

Happy to adjust — LMK what works and I’ll lock the invites.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- enablement_prework.pdf (1 page)
- console_agenda_v1.docx (draft)

Hi Ben — thanks for the clear options. Splitting across two windows makes a lot of sense for our team. A few quick items:

- Attendees: myself (PM), Tom Larkin (Dev Lead, I've cc'd him), two SREs (TBD), and one security rep (if possible).
- Network: we use an outbound allowlist for integrations; I'll confirm whether we need an inbound exception. If so I'll share the contact in the SRE team.
- Times: the EMEA-friendly slot looks good, but could we move it 30 minutes earlier (so start at 15:30 PT)? That maps better to 23:30 CET for one of our night-shift teams.

Also, can the API session include 20–30 minutes of hands-on SDK setup (we'll be on Mac/Linux dev machines)? Tom will prepare any questions about auth and token rotation.

I'll confirm the SRE names by EOD tomorrow and share any firewall details. Thanks — looking forward to the sessions.

Best,
Alice Zhao
Director, Platform Product
